name: Sharks & rays
description: Sharks, rays and skates - the elasmobranch predators of the shelf and the shallow coast, from guitarfish and eagle rays inshore to deep-water catsharks and seven-gill sharks offshore. Functional group pooling the source's coastal-selacians and shelf-selacians compartments - one shark-and-ray guild that the source split by habitat; pooled here to fit this atlas's 25-node ceiling. Shelf selacians import 21% of their diet from beyond the modelled system, so this node's weights sum to about 0.89.
